_readme: DRAFT rules. Every scheme below has verified=false. Before publishing the demo, open each official page, correct the conditions, documents and steps, then set verified=true and checked_on to today's date (YYYY-MM-DD).

schemes.name: Apni Chhat Apna Ghar - new house construction (Punjab)

conditions.note: Age 21 to 60 at time of application

other_official_criteria: Sole owner and possessor of land up to 5 Marla (urban) or 10 Marla (rural)
documents: The official site lists the required documents when you apply. Please check it before you go, or call 0800-09100.
steps: Go to the official website acag.punjab.gov.pk and choose "Apply for Construction of New House".
Follow the instructions on the official site, or call the helpline 0800-09100.

schemes.name: Apni Chhat Mehfooz Chhat - add floor/room (Punjab)

conditions.note: Age 21 to 60 at time of application

other_official_criteria: Registered in NSER/PSER with PMT score of 60 or less
Owner of a constructed house up to 5 Marla (urban) or 10 Marla (rural)
documents: The official site lists the required documents when you apply. Please check it before you go, or call 0800-09100.

Follow the instructions on the official site, or call the helpline 0800-09100.
